data.body: **P2 — Bound synthesized starts by the supplied end timestamp.** A terminal external update may legally omit `StartTimestamp` while carrying an older backend `EndTimestamp`. This falls back to the resumed invocation clock for the start but preserves the historical end, producing `start > end`; failed spans also place their exception event before the span. Resolve the end first and ensure a missing/local start is no later than it, apply the same invariant to attempt spans, and add an external-completion regression test with no start timestamp.
